```{r}
folder_path <- "."

csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Separate output, answer, and data files
output_file <- csv_files[grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files)]
answer_file <- csv_files[grepl("sensor_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]
data_files  <- csv_files[!grepl("output\\.csv$", csv_files) &
                         !grepl("sensor_answer\\.csv$", csv_files)]

# Read output and answer files
output <- read.csv(output_file, header = TRUE)
cat("output loaded: ", nrow(output), "rows, ", ncol(output), "columns\n")

answer <- read.csv(answer_file, header = TRUE)
cat("answer loaded: ", nrow(answer), "rows, ", ncol(answer), "columns\n")

# Read the remaining files as dat_1, dat_2, ...
for (i in seq_along(data_files)) {
  tryCatch({
    dat <- read.csv(data_files[i], header = TRUE)
    assign(paste0("dat_", i), dat)
    cat(paste0("dat_", i, " loaded: ", basename(data_files[i]),
               " (", nrow(dat), " rows, ", ncol(dat), " columns) \n"))
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(paste0("Skip: ", basename(data_files[i]), " -> ", e$message, "\n"))
  })
}
rm(dat)
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:127) {
  dat_name <- paste0("dat_", i)
  dat <- get(dat_name)
  dat <- dat[grepl("^video/", dat$Video, ignore.case = FALSE), ]
  assign(dat_name, dat)
}
rm(dat)
cat("Complete: retained all rows beginning with video/\n")
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:127) {
  dat_name <- paste0("dat_", i)
  dat <- get(dat_name)

  # Merge the output time column using Video as the key
  dat <- merge(dat, output[, c("key", "time")],
               by.x = "Video", by.y = "key",
               all.x = TRUE)

  assign(dat_name, dat)
}
rm(dat)
cat("Complete: time column added to all datasets\n")
```

```{r}
for (i in 1:127) {
  dat_name <- paste0("dat_", i)
  dat <- get(dat_name)

  # Use match instead of merge to preserve row counts
  idx <- match(dat$Video, answer$Video)
  dat$key_resp_9.corr <- ifelse(dat$key_resp_9.keys == answer$SM_Ans[idx], 1, 0)

  assign(dat_name, dat)
}

rm(dat)
cat("Complete: key_resp_9.corr added to all datasets\n")
```

```{r}
dvs <- list(
  T_encode    = quote(sensor_experiment_question.stopped - sensor_experiment_question.started),
  RT_onset    = quote(key_resp_9.rt),
  RT_critical = quote(key_resp_9.rt - time),
  ACC         = quote(key_resp_9.corr)
)

outlier_results <- lapply(names(dvs), function(dv_name) {
  vals <- eval(dvs[[dv_name]], envir = all_cat)
  all_cat %>%
    mutate(value = vals) %>%
    group_by(participant) %>%
    mutate(
      p_mean  = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      p_sd    = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE),
      z_score = (value - p_mean) / p_sd
    ) %>%
    filter(abs(z_score) > 3) %>%
    mutate(variable = dv_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(participant, variable, value, p_mean, p_sd, z_score)
})

all_outliers <- bind_rows(outlier_results)

# Participant-level exception cases
all_outliers %>%
  group_by(participant, variable) %>%
  summarise(n_outliers = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(participant, variable) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = variable,
    values_from = n_outliers,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(total = T_encode + RT_onset + RT_critical + ACC) %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  print(n=124)
```

```{r}
summarize_dat <- function(dat) {
  dat %>%
    summarise(
      # T_encode
      mean_T_encode     = mean(sensor_experiment_question.stopped - sensor_experiment_question.started, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_T_encode       = sd(sensor_experiment_question.stopped   - sensor_experiment_question.started, na.rm = TRUE),

      # RT_onset
      mean_RT_onset     = mean(key_resp_9.rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_RT_onset       = sd(key_resp_9.rt,   na.rm = TRUE),

      # RT_critical
      mean_RT_critical  = mean(key_resp_9.rt - time, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_RT_critical    = sd(key_resp_9.rt   - time, na.rm = TRUE),

      # ACC
      mean_ACC          = mean(key_resp_9.corr, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_ACC            = sd(key_resp_9.corr,   na.rm = TRUE),

      # IES_onset
      mean_IES_onset    = mean(key_resp_9.rt / mean(key_resp_9.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_IES_onset      = sd(key_resp_9.rt   / mean(key_resp_9.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),

      # IES_critical
      mean_IES_critical = mean((key_resp_9.rt - time) / mean(key_resp_9.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_IES_critical   = sd((key_resp_9.rt   - time) / mean(key_resp_9.corr, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
    )
}

# Generate and merge all summaries
all_summary <- bind_rows(
  lapply(1:127, function(i) {
    dat <- get(paste0("dat_", i))
    summarize_dat(dat) %>%
      mutate(participant = dat$participant[1])
  })
) %>% select(participant, everything())

write.csv(all_summary,
          file = "../../data_analysis/ex_2_sensor/all_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Export complete!\n")
cat("Complete!\n")

```

```{r}
# Filter correct trials and generate summary
all_summary_correct <- bind_rows(
  lapply(1:127, function(i) {
    dat <- get(paste0("dat_", i))
    dat_c <- dat[dat$key_resp_9.corr == 1, ]
    summarize_dat(dat_c) %>%
      mutate(participant = dat_c$participant[1])
  })
) %>% select(participant, everything())

# Export
write.csv(all_summary_correct,
          file = "../../data_analysis/ex_2_sensor/with_correct_trial.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("Export complete!\n")
print(all_summary_correct)
```
